name: Casa Monte Halcones
description:
Casa Monte Halcones is located in the elevated residential area of Monte Halcones, Benahavís, enjoying spectacular panoramic views across the Mediterranean coastline and surrounding landscape. Set within a peaceful community, the property offers a sense of privacy and tranquillity while remaining within easy reach of renowned golf courses, local restaurants and cafés, supermarkets, San Pedro de Alcántara, Puerto Banús, and the wider Marbella area.

Recently renovated throughout, this stylish two-bedroom apartment combines contemporary design with warm natural finishes and a calm, sophisticated atmosphere. With accommodation for up to four guests, it is an ideal choice for couples, families, or friends looking for a modern and comfortable base from which to enjoy the Costa del Sol.

On entering the property, guests are welcomed into a bright open-plan living and dining area designed to make the most of the natural light and impressive views. The living space features a comfortable sofa, contemporary furnishings, and a wall-mounted Smart TV, while the adjacent dining area offers seating for four guests. Large glass doors connect the interior directly with the private terrace, creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living.

The open-plan kitchen is modern and fully equipped, featuring sleek cabinetry, quality Bosch appliances, an induction hob, oven, microwave, fridge and freezer, dishwasher, as well as tableware, cutlery, and kitchen utensils for a comfortable self-catering stay.

The property features two thoughtfully designed bedrooms. The master bedroom is furnished with a generous 180 x 200 cm bed and offers a calm, elegant setting for relaxation. The second bedroom features a 150 x 190 cm double bed and follows the same contemporary aesthetic, making the apartment particularly well suited to up to four guests.

There are two beautifully finished bathrooms, both designed with modern materials and refined details. The principal bathroom features a double porcelain basin, a custom-made walnut vanity with storage, a large LED-lit mirror, and a walk-in shower. The second bathroom is equally well appointed, with a porcelain basin, custom-made walnut vanity, illuminated mirror, and walk-in shower.

One of the property’s standout features is its private furnished terrace, where guests can enjoy far-reaching panoramic views towards the Mediterranean Sea and surrounding hills. The terrace includes an outdoor dining area, comfortable seating, and a barbecue, creating the perfect setting for relaxed breakfasts, long lunches, or evening drinks while taking in the scenery.

Guests also have access to the beautifully maintained communal swimming pool and surrounding outdoor areas, offering an inviting place to cool off and unwind during Marbella’s warmer months.

With its elevated position, contemporary interiors, exceptional views, and convenient access to the best of Benahavís, San Pedro de Alcántara, Puerto Banús, and Marbella, Casa Monte Halcones offers an elegant retreat for guests seeking both tranquillity and proximity to the Costa del Sol’s beaches, golf courses, restaurants, and lifestyle.

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

Don’t forget to ask about our Concierge Service! We look forward to welcoming you.
